name: ox-cli-brief-pane
description: What SageOx gave this session, in a scrollable pane beside the chat: each ox call, the context ox put in front of the model, and what was read, plus a one-line lane under each ox call showing what moved between SageOx and the session. /ox-session-report opens, refreshes, and closes it; /ox-session-report flow on|off|still sets the lanes.
